label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (java/sql-injection): alert-TP — The sink 'sql' is constructed by concatenating 'bar' into a SQL string literal. In doSomething(), the condition (500 / 42) + 196 > 200 evaluates to true (207 > 200), resolving 'bar' to 'param'. 'param' derives from request.getQueryString() without sanitization. Thus, the resolved sink value is attacker-controlled input embedded in the SQL string.
